---
title: "Depth state model: agreement with ichorCNA v0.6.1, planted gains and scaling"
output:
  github_document:
    html_preview: false
    pandoc_args: ["--wrap=preserve", "--columns=400"]
---

This report validates phase 2 of the depth fraction lane
(`design/depth_fraction_lane.md`, https://github.com/RGenomicsETL/duckhts/issues/343):
`duckhts_depth_state_solutions()` and `duckhts_depth_state_segments()`, a port of the
ichorCNA copy-number state model. It runs the port and the unmodified upstream R code
(GavinHaLab/ichorCNA tag v0.6.1 with HMMcopy 1.54.0, `benchmarks/depth_state/upstream_ichorcna.R`)
on the same corrected bins and compares fraction, ploidy, guard and segments; checks planted
chromosome-18 gains and samples without change at 0.1×, 0.4× and 1×; and gives the 1×/2×/4×
scaling evidence `STYLE.md` asks for. No earlier report measures these macros; this is their
first baseline.

The real bins are the composites of `benchmarks/benchmark_depth_fraction.md`: sums of
read-name buckets of three registered 30× genomes, corrected with `duckhts_depth_bins()` and
masked by the leave-one-out panel rule of that report. Upstream cannot take corrected bins
through its command line, which applies its own loess correction, so its model is entered at
the function level that `run_ichorCNA` calls after correction: `getDefaultParameters`,
`HMMsegment` and `correctIntegerCN` with `run_ichorCNA`'s default arguments, plus its guard.

stopifnot(requireNamespace("duckhtsbench", quietly = TRUE),

Sys.setenv(DUCKHTSBENCH_REGISTRY = normalizePath(

extension <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("DUCKHTS_EXTENSION", "build/release/duckhts.duckdb_extension"),

duckdb_cli <- Sys.getenv("DUCKDB_CLI", Sys.which("duckdb"))

src_tree <- system2("git", c("rev-parse", "HEAD:src"), stdout = TRUE)

results_dir <- "benchmarks/results/depth-state"
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

run_untimed <- function(statements, outputs = list()) {
  scratch <- tempfile("depth-state-untimed-")
  dir.create(scratch)
  on.exit(unlink(scratch, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  paths <- file.path(scratch, paste0(names(outputs), ".csv"))
  copies <- vapply(seq_along(outputs), function(k) {
    sprintf("COPY (%s) TO %s (HEADER);", outputs[[k]], quote_literal(paths[[k]]))
  }, character(1L))
  sql_path <- file.path(scratch, "script.sql")
  writeLines(c("SET threads = 4;", sprintf("LOAD %s;", quote_literal(extension)), statements, copies),
             sql_path)
  status <- system2(duckdb_cli, c("-unsigned", "-batch", "-bail"), stdin = sql_path,
                    stdout = "", stderr = "")
  if (status != 0L) stop("DuckDB CLI failed (status ", status, ")")
  results <- lapply(paths, utils::read.csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(results) <- names(outputs)
  results
}

run_fresh <- function(query, threads, setup = NULL) {
  scratch <- tempfile("depth-state-scaling-")
  dir.create(scratch)
  on.exit(unlink(scratch, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  sql_path <- file.path(scratch, "query.sql")
  result_path <- file.path(scratch, "result.csv")
  profile_path <- file.path(scratch, "profile.json")
  time_path <- file.path(scratch, "time.tsv")
  writeLines(c(
    sprintf("SET threads = %d;", threads),
    "SET max_temp_directory_size = '0KiB';",
    sprintf("LOAD %s;", quote_literal(extension)),
    setup,
    "PRAGMA enable_profiling = 'json';",
    sprintf("PRAGMA profiling_output = %s;", quote_literal(profile_path)),
    sprintf("COPY (%s) TO %s (HEADER);", query, quote_literal(result_path)),
    "PRAGMA disable_profiling;"
  ), sql_path)
  status <- system2("/usr/bin/time", c("-f", shQuote("%M\t%e"), "-o", shQuote(time_path),
                                       "nice", "-n", "-15", shQuote(duckdb_cli), "-unsigned", "-batch", "-bail"),
                    stdin = sql_path, stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE)
  if (status != 0L) stop("DuckDB CLI failed (status ", status, ")")
  profile <- jsonlite::fromJSON(profile_path, simplifyVector = TRUE)
  timing <- utils::read.delim(time_path, header = FALSE, col.names = c("max_rss_kib", "process_seconds"))
  data.frame(utils::read.csv(result_path, colClasses = "character"),
             seconds = as.numeric(profile$latency), max_rss_kib = timing$max_rss_kib[[1L]],
             process_seconds = timing$process_seconds[[1L]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

## Declaration, before any run

Composites, from the design of the depth fraction report: for each of the genomes
HG00403, NA18507 and HG00188, a pure sample at 0.1×, 0.4× and 1× (10, 40 and 100 of the
300 read-name buckets); and HG00403 with extra chromosome-18 buckets so that chromosome 18
has the depth of a one-copy gain in a share `m` of cells, `m` = 0.2 and 0.4 at 0.1×, 0.1 and
0.2 at 0.4×, 0.04, 0.1 and 0.2 at 1×. The gain series is the dilution series: the same
change at decreasing share. Each composite is corrected alone with `duckhts_depth_bins()`
(1 Mb bins, GC from the GRCh38 reference, bins with 5% or more N and the X
pseudo-autosomal regions removed) and keeps the bins that the other two genomes, at
30×, correct to a ratio within 0.75 and 1.25 (the panel mask of the depth fraction report).
Y is dropped; X is decoded and not trained on. Both models run the default grid, normal
fractions 0.5 to 0.9 at ploidy starts 2 and 3, with `max_cn` 7.

Criteria:

- **A1, best solution.** For every composite, the port and upstream rank the same start first,
  or their best solutions agree within the A2 tolerances.
- **A2, parameters.** For the best solution of every composite, the normal fractions differ by at
  most 0.02 and the ploidies by at most 0.05; the guard decision is the same.
- **A3, segments.** For the best solution of every composite, the Viterbi states agree on at
  least 98% of bins.
- **A4, every start.** Over all composites and starts, at least 90% of the starts have normal
  fractions within 0.02, ploidies within 0.05 and objectives within 5 of upstream. The rest are
  listed; a difference on a flat objective is the expected effect of the two optimizers.
- **G1, gains.** For each gain composite the port's best solution has a ploidy within 0.15 of 2,
  chromosome 18 at three copies over at least 90% of its kept bins, no other autosome with more
  than 10% of its bins altered, and a tumour fraction within 0.05 of `m` at 0.4× and 1× and within
  0.08 at 0.1×.
- **N1, no change.** For each pure composite, the best solution of the port and of upstream has a
  tumour fraction of at most 0.02.
- **S1, scaling.** On synthetic bins in fresh processes with four threads: with one sample, the
  latency at 2× and 4× bins is at most 2.6× and 6.8× that at 1× (exponent at most 1.4); with
  four samples of the 1× size, at most 2× the one-sample latency; peak RSS stays under 1 GiB
  throughout. The model's declared memory is about `max_cn * 28 + 40` bytes a bin per sample
  in flight.

```{r design, echo=FALSE}
component <- function(id, genome, contigs, low, high) {
  data.frame(test_id = id, genome = genome, contigs = contigs, low = low, high = high,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
genomes <- c("HG00403", "NA18507", "HG00188")
depths <- data.frame(label = c("0.1x", "0.4x", "1x"), buckets = c(10L, 40L, 100L))
gains <- list(`0.1x` = c(0.2, 0.4), `0.4x` = c(0.1, 0.2), `1x` = c(0.04, 0.1, 0.2))
components <- list()
design <- list()
add_test <- function(id, kind, depth, truth, genome_set, parts) {
  components[[length(components) + 1L]] <<- parts
  design[[length(design) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(test_id = id, kind = kind, depth = depth, truth = truth,
                                               genomes = genome_set, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
for (d in seq_len(nrow(depths))) {
  label <- depths$label[[d]]
  n <- depths$buckets[[d]]
  for (genome in genomes) {
    add_test(paste("pure", genome, label), "pure", label, 0, genome,
             component(paste("pure", genome, label), genome, "all", 0L, n))
  }
  for (m in gains[[label]]) {
    id <- paste("gain chr18", m, label)
    add_test(id, "gain", label, m, "HG00403", rbind(
      component(id, "HG00403", "all", 0L, n),
      component(id, "HG00403", "chr18", n, n + as.integer(round(m * n / 2)))))
  }
}
components <- do.call(rbind, components)
design <- do.call(rbind, design)
stopifnot(all(components$high <= 300L), all(components$high > components$low))
knitr::kable(design, caption = "The composites")
```

## Execution and provenance

```{r real, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
registry <- duckhtsbench::duckhts_bench_registry()
identity_of <- function(id) {
  duckhtsbench:::duckhts_bench_identity_fields(registry$supplier_identity[registry$id == id])
}
bucket_ids <- paste0("depth_fraction_", tolower(genomes), "_buckets")
bucket_paths <- vapply(bucket_ids, duckhtsbench::duckhts_bench_artifact_path, character(1L))
stopifnot(all(file.exists(bucket_paths)))
bucket_provenance <- lapply(seq_along(bucket_ids), function(k) {
  receipt <- utils::read.delim(paste0(bucket_paths[[k]], ".sources.tsv"), colClasses = "character")
  value <- setNames(receipt$value, receipt$field)
  stopifnot(value[["artifact_id"]] == bucket_ids[[k]],
            value[["output_sha256"]] == unname(digest::digest(file = bucket_paths[[k]], algo = "sha256")))
  data.frame(artifact = bucket_ids[[k]], producer_sha256 = value[["extension_sha256"]],
             output_sha256 = value[["output_sha256"]])
})
knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, bucket_provenance))
reference_fasta <- duckhtsbench::duckhts_bench_artifact_path("liftover_grch38_fasta")
stopifnot(file.exists(reference_fasta), file.exists(paste0(reference_fasta, ".fai")))
duckhtsbench::duckhts_bench_validate_identity("liftover_grch38_fasta", reference_fasta)
bucket_list <- paste(vapply(bucket_paths, quote_literal, character(1L)), collapse = ", ")
staged <- run_untimed(character(), list(identity = sprintf(paste(
  "SELECT sample_id, count(*)::DOUBLE AS rows, sum(reads)::DOUBLE AS reads, max(bucket) AS max_bucket",
  "FROM read_parquet([%s]) GROUP BY sample_id ORDER BY sample_id"), bucket_list)))$identity
for (k in seq_along(genomes)) {
  fields <- identity_of(bucket_ids[[k]])
  row <- staged[staged$sample_id == genomes[[k]], ]
  stopifnot(nrow(row) == 1L, row$rows == as.numeric(fields[["rows"]]),
            row$reads == as.numeric(fields[["reads"]]))
}

components_sql <- paste(sprintf("(%s, %s, %s, %d, %d)", vapply(components$test_id, quote_literal, ""),
                                 vapply(components$genome, quote_literal, ""),
                                 vapply(components$contigs, quote_literal, ""), components$low, components$high),
                         collapse = ", ")
corrected_path <- normalizePath(file.path(results_dir, "corrected_bins.parquet"), mustWork = FALSE)
real_setup <- c(
  sprintf(paste(
    "CREATE TABLE gc AS SELECT chrom, start, \"end\", (num_c + num_g) / nullif(num_a + num_c + num_g + num_t, 0) AS gc",
    "FROM fasta_nuc(%s, bin_width := 1000000) WHERE (chrom IN ('chrX', 'chrY') OR regexp_full_match(chrom, 'chr[0-9]+'))",
    "AND num_n < 0.05 * seq_len AND NOT (chrom = 'chrX' AND (start < 2781479 OR \"end\" > 155701383));"),
    quote_literal(reference_fasta)),
  sprintf(paste("CREATE TABLE buckets AS SELECT sample_id, chrom, start // 1000000 * 1000000 AS start, bucket,",
                "sum(reads) AS reads FROM read_parquet([%s]) GROUP BY ALL;"), bucket_list),
  sprintf("CREATE TABLE components AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES %s) v(test_id, genome, contigs, low, high);",
          components_sql),
  paste("CREATE MACRO composed_bins(parts) AS TABLE SELECT t.test_id AS sample_id, g.chrom, g.start, g.\"end\",",
        "coalesce(c.reads, 0) AS reads, g.gc FROM gc g CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT test_id FROM query_table(parts)) t",
        "LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.test_id, b.chrom, b.start, sum(b.reads) AS reads FROM query_table(parts) p",
        "JOIN buckets b ON b.sample_id = p.genome AND b.bucket >= p.low AND b.bucket < p.high",
        "AND (p.contigs = 'all' OR (p.contigs = 'autosomes' AND b.chrom NOT IN ('chrX', 'chrY')) OR b.chrom = p.contigs)",
        "GROUP BY ALL) c ON c.test_id = t.test_id AND c.chrom = g.chrom AND c.start = g.start;"),
  sprintf(paste("CREATE TABLE panel_parts AS SELECT genome AS test_id, genome, 'all' AS contigs, 0 AS low, 300 AS high",
                "FROM (VALUES %s) v(genome);"), paste0("(", vapply(genomes, quote_literal, character(1L)), ")", collapse = ", ")),
  "CREATE TABLE panel_bins AS SELECT * FROM composed_bins('panel_parts');",
  "CREATE TABLE panel AS SELECT * FROM duckhts_depth_bins('panel_bins');",
  "CREATE TABLE corrected (sample_id VARCHAR, chrom VARCHAR, start BIGINT, \"end\" BIGINT, log2_ratio DOUBLE, kept BOOLEAN);")
group_sql <- function(genome) {
  others <- setdiff(genomes, genome)
  in_list <- function(x) paste(vapply(x, quote_literal, character(1L)), collapse = ", ")
  tests <- design$test_id[design$genomes == genome]
  c(sprintf(paste("CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mask AS SELECT chrom, start FROM panel WHERE kept AND sample_id IN (%s)",
                  "GROUP BY chrom, start HAVING median(ratio / CASE WHEN chrom IN ('chrX', 'chrY') THEN 0.5 ELSE 1.0 END)",
                  "BETWEEN 0.75 AND 1.25;"), in_list(others)),
    sprintf("CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE parts AS SELECT * FROM components WHERE test_id IN (%s);", in_list(tests)),
    "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE test_bins AS SELECT b.* FROM composed_bins('parts') b SEMI JOIN mask USING (chrom, start);",
    paste("INSERT INTO corrected SELECT sample_id, chrom, start, \"end\", log2_ratio, kept",
          "FROM duckhts_depth_bins('test_bins') WHERE chrom <> 'chrY';"))
}
real_results <- run_untimed(c(
  real_setup,
  unlist(lapply(genomes, group_sql)),
  sprintf("COPY (SELECT * FROM corrected WHERE kept ORDER BY sample_id, chrom, start) TO %s (FORMAT parquet);",
          quote_literal(corrected_path)),
  "CREATE TABLE solutions AS SELECT * FROM duckhts_depth_state_solutions('corrected');",
  "CREATE TABLE segments AS SELECT * FROM duckhts_depth_state_segments('corrected');"),
  list(bins = "SELECT sample_id, chrom, start, \"end\", log2_ratio FROM corrected WHERE kept ORDER BY sample_id, chrom, start",
       kept = "SELECT sample_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kept) AS kept, count(*) AS bins FROM corrected GROUP BY sample_id ORDER BY sample_id",
       solutions = "SELECT * FROM solutions ORDER BY sample_id, solution",
       segments = "SELECT * FROM segments ORDER BY sample_id, solution, chrom, start"))
utils::write.csv(real_results$solutions, file.path(results_dir, "solutions_duckhts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(real_results$segments, gzfile(file.path(results_dir, "segments_duckhts.csv.gz")), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(real_results$kept, caption = "Kept bins per composite after the panel mask")
```

```{r upstream, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
source("benchmarks/depth_state/upstream_ichorcna.R")
upstream_env <- load_upstream_ichorcna(".")
bins <- real_results$bins
upstream <- lapply(split(bins, bins$sample_id), function(sample_bins) {
  sample_bins <- sample_bins[order(sample_bins$chrom, sample_bins$start), ]
  fit <- upstream_state_model(upstream_env, sample_bins[, c("chrom", "start", "end", "log2_ratio")])
  fit$solutions$sample_id <- sample_bins$sample_id[[1L]]
  fit$states$sample_id <- sample_bins$sample_id[[1L]]
  fit$segments$sample_id <- sample_bins$sample_id[[1L]]
  fit
})
upstream_solutions <- do.call(rbind, lapply(upstream, `[[`, "solutions"))
upstream_states <- do.call(rbind, lapply(upstream, `[[`, "states"))
upstream_segments <- do.call(rbind, lapply(upstream, `[[`, "segments"))
utils::write.csv(upstream_solutions, file.path(results_dir, "solutions_upstream.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(upstream_segments, gzfile(file.path(results_dir, "segments_upstream.csv.gz")), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Agreement with upstream

```{r agreement, echo=FALSE}
ours <- real_results$solutions
joined <- merge(ours, upstream_solutions, by = c("sample_id", "start_normal", "start_ploidy"),
                suffixes = c("", "_upstream"))
joined$dn <- abs(joined$normal_fraction - joined$normal_fraction_upstream)
joined$dphi <- abs(joined$ploidy - joined$ploidy_upstream)
joined$dlik <- abs(joined$log_likelihood - joined$log_likelihood_upstream)
joined$within <- joined$dn <= 0.02 & joined$dphi <= 0.05 & joined$dlik <= 5
best_ours <- ours[ours$solution == 1, ]
best_upstream <- upstream_solutions[upstream_solutions$solution == 1, ]
# The port's best solution's Viterbi state of each bin, from its segments.
best_states <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(bins, bins$sample_id), function(sample_bins) {
  segs <- real_results$segments
  segs <- segs[segs$sample_id == sample_bins$sample_id[[1L]] & segs$solution == 1, ]
  hit <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(sample_bins)), function(i) {
    j <- which(segs$chrom == sample_bins$chrom[[i]] & segs$start <= sample_bins$start[[i]] &
                 segs$end >= sample_bins$end[[i]])
    if (length(j) == 1L) segs$state[[j]] else NA_integer_
  }, integer(1L))
  data.frame(sample_id = sample_bins$sample_id, chrom = sample_bins$chrom, start = sample_bins$start,
             state = hit, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
agreement <- do.call(rbind, lapply(design$test_id, function(id) {
  o <- best_ours[best_ours$sample_id == id, ]
  u <- best_upstream[best_upstream$sample_id == id, ]
  mine <- best_states[best_states$sample_id == id, ]
  theirs <- upstream_states[upstream_states$sample_id == id & upstream_states$start_normal == u$start_normal &
                              upstream_states$start_ploidy == u$start_ploidy, ]
  both <- merge(mine, theirs, by = c("sample_id", "chrom", "start"), suffixes = c("", "_upstream"))
  same_start <- o$start_normal == u$start_normal && o$start_ploidy == u$start_ploidy
  dn <- abs(o$normal_fraction - u$normal_fraction)
  dphi <- abs(o$ploidy - u$ploidy)
  data.frame(
    test_id = id, same_start = same_start, normal_duckhts = o$normal_fraction, normal_upstream = u$normal_fraction,
    ploidy_duckhts = o$ploidy, ploidy_upstream = u$ploidy, guard_duckhts = o$status == "guard_zero",
    guard_upstream = u$guard_zero, state_agreement = mean(both$state == both$state_upstream),
    A1 = same_start || (dn <= 0.02 && dphi <= 0.05),
    A2 = dn <= 0.02 && dphi <= 0.05 && (o$status == "guard_zero") == u$guard_zero,
    A3 = mean(both$state == both$state_upstream) >= 0.98, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
utils::write.csv(agreement, file.path(results_dir, "agreement_best.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(joined[, c("sample_id", "start_normal", "start_ploidy", "normal_fraction", "normal_fraction_upstream",
                            "ploidy", "ploidy_upstream", "log_likelihood", "log_likelihood_upstream", "dn", "dphi", "dlik", "within")],
                 file.path(results_dir, "agreement_starts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(agreement, digits = 4, caption = "Best solutions: the port against upstream")
a4_share <- mean(joined$within)
outside <- joined[!joined$within, c("sample_id", "start_normal", "start_ploidy", "normal_fraction", "normal_fraction_upstream",
                                    "ploidy", "ploidy_upstream", "dlik")]
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  criterion = c("A1", "A2", "A3", "A4"),
  composites = c(sum(agreement$A1), sum(agreement$A2), sum(agreement$A3), NA),
  of = c(nrow(agreement), nrow(agreement), nrow(agreement), NA),
  starts_within = c(NA, NA, NA, sprintf("%.1f%% of %d", 100 * a4_share, nrow(joined))),
  pass = c(all(agreement$A1), all(agreement$A2), all(agreement$A3), a4_share >= 0.9)))
if (nrow(outside) > 0) knitr::kable(outside, digits = 4, caption = "Starts outside the A4 tolerances")
# Observation, not a declared criterion: the same comparison restricted to the
# composites where either model's best solution reports a tumour fraction above
# 0.02. Below that, the normal fraction is near 1, the state means lie within
# the noise of each other, and ploidy and states are not identified.
informative <- agreement$test_id[(1 - agreement$normal_duckhts) > 0.02 | (1 - agreement$normal_upstream) > 0.02]
informative_rows <- agreement[agreement$test_id %in% informative, ]
higher <- sum(joined$log_likelihood[!joined$within] > joined$log_likelihood_upstream[!joined$within] + 1)
lower <- sum(joined$log_likelihood[!joined$within] < joined$log_likelihood_upstream[!joined$within] - 1)
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  composites_with_a_fraction = nrow(informative_rows),
  A1 = sum(informative_rows$A1), A2 = sum(informative_rows$A2), A3 = sum(informative_rows$A3),
  starts_outside_A4 = sum(!joined$within), port_objective_higher_by_1 = higher, upstream_objective_higher_by_1 = lower),
  caption = "Observation: agreement among the composites with a reported fraction, and which optimizer ended higher where the starts differ")
```

## Planted gains and samples without change

```{r gains, echo=FALSE}
segs <- real_results$segments
gain_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(design$test_id[design$kind == "gain"], function(id) {
  truth <- design$truth[design$test_id == id]
  depth <- design$depth[design$test_id == id]
  o <- best_ours[best_ours$sample_id == id, ]
  u <- best_upstream[best_upstream$sample_id == id, ]
  mine <- best_states[best_states$sample_id == id, ]
  chr18 <- mean(mine$state[mine$chrom == "chr18"] == 3)
  chr18_state <- as.integer(names(which.max(table(mine$state[mine$chrom == "chr18"]))))
  theirs <- upstream_states[upstream_states$sample_id == id & upstream_states$start_normal == u$start_normal &
                              upstream_states$start_ploidy == u$start_ploidy, ]
  chr18_state_upstream <- as.integer(names(which.max(table(theirs$state[theirs$chrom == "chr18"]))))
  chr18_median <- median(bins$log2_ratio[bins$sample_id == id & bins$chrom == "chr18"], na.rm = TRUE)
  autosomes <- mine[!mine$chrom %in% c("chrX", "chrY") & mine$chrom != "chr18", ]
  worst_other <- max(tapply(autosomes$state != 2, autosomes$chrom, mean))
  tolerance <- if (depth == "0.1x") 0.08 else 0.05
  data.frame(test_id = id, depth = depth, truth = truth, designed_log2 = log2(1 + truth / 2),
             chr18_median_log2 = chr18_median, tumour_fraction = 1 - o$normal_fraction,
             tumour_fraction_upstream = 1 - u$normal_fraction, ploidy = o$ploidy, status = o$status,
             chr18_copies = chr18_state, chr18_copies_upstream = chr18_state_upstream,
             extra_copies_times_fraction = (chr18_state - 2) * (1 - o$normal_fraction),
             chr18_three_copies = chr18, worst_other_altered = worst_other,
             G1 = abs(o$ploidy - 2) <= 0.15 && chr18 >= 0.9 && worst_other <= 0.1 &&
               abs((1 - o$normal_fraction) - truth) <= tolerance, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
utils::write.csv(gain_rows, file.path(results_dir, "gains.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(gain_rows, digits = 4, caption = "Planted chromosome-18 gains: the best solution of the port, with the copy number both models give chromosome 18")
pure_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(design$test_id[design$kind == "pure"], function(id) {
  o <- best_ours[best_ours$sample_id == id, ]
  u <- best_upstream[best_upstream$sample_id == id, ]
  data.frame(test_id = id, tumour_fraction = 1 - o$normal_fraction, status = o$status,
             tumour_fraction_upstream = 1 - u$normal_fraction, guard_upstream = u$guard_zero,
             N1 = (1 - o$normal_fraction) <= 0.02 && (1 - u$normal_fraction) <= 0.02, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
utils::write.csv(pure_rows, file.path(results_dir, "pure.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(pure_rows, digits = 4, caption = "Samples without change")
```

## Scaling

```{r scaling, echo=FALSE}
synthetic_setup <- function(bins_per_contig, samples) {
  c("CREATE MACRO ds_u(salt, sample_id, chrom, bin) AS (hash(salt, sample_id, chrom, bin) % 1000003 + 0.5) / 1000003.0;",
    paste("CREATE MACRO ds_normal(sample_id, chrom, bin) AS",
          "sqrt(-2 * ln(ds_u('a', sample_id, chrom, bin))) * cos(2 * pi() * ds_u('b', sample_id, chrom, bin));"),
    sprintf(paste("CREATE TABLE bins AS SELECT 'S' || s AS sample_id, CAST(c AS VARCHAR) AS chrom,",
                  "b * 1000000 AS start, (b + 1) * 1000000 AS \"end\", true AS kept,",
                  "log2(CASE WHEN c = 8 THEN 1.15 WHEN c = 13 THEN 0.85 ELSE 1 END) + 0.06 * ds_normal('S' || s, c, b) AS log2_ratio",
                  "FROM range(1, 23) t(c), range(0, %d) r(b), range(1, %d) q(s);"), bins_per_contig, samples + 1L))
}
scaling_runs <- data.frame(label = c("1x bins", "2x bins", "4x bins", "2 samples", "4 samples"),
                           bins_per_contig = c(136L, 272L, 544L, 136L, 136L), samples = c(1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 4L))
scaling <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(scaling_runs)), function(k) {
  run <- run_fresh("SELECT count(*) AS solutions, sum(bins) AS bins FROM duckhts_depth_state_solutions('bins')",
                   threads = 4, setup = synthetic_setup(scaling_runs$bins_per_contig[[k]], scaling_runs$samples[[k]]))
  data.frame(scaling_runs[k, ], bins = as.numeric(run$bins), solutions = as.integer(run$solutions),
             seconds = run$seconds, max_rss_mib = run$max_rss_kib / 1024)
}))
utils::write.csv(scaling, file.path(results_dir, "scaling.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
base <- scaling$seconds[[1L]]
exponent <- log(scaling$seconds[[3L]] / base) / log(4)
s1 <- scaling$seconds[[2L]] <= 2.6 * base && scaling$seconds[[3L]] <= 6.8 * base &&
  scaling$seconds[[5L]] <= 2 * base && all(scaling$max_rss_mib < 1024)
knitr::kable(scaling, digits = 3, caption = "Fresh processes, four threads, spill forbidden")
```

The latency exponent over 1×, 2× and 4× bins is `r sprintf("%.2f", exponent)`; four samples of the
1× size take `r sprintf("%.2f", scaling$seconds[[5L]] / base)`× the one-sample latency; S1
`r if (s1) "passes" else "fails"`. One decode runs per sample on the thread that holds that
sample's row, so parallelism across samples depends on how DuckDB spreads the per-sample rows
over threads; it is not a property of the kernel.

## Findings

- **Declared criteria.** A1 holds for `r sum(agreement$A1)` of `r nrow(agreement)` composites, A2
  for `r sum(agreement$A2)`, A3 for `r sum(agreement$A3)`; A4 has
  `r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * a4_share)` of starts within tolerance
  (`r if (a4_share >= 0.9) "passes" else "fails"`). G1 holds for `r sum(gain_rows$G1)` of
  `r nrow(gain_rows)` gain composites; N1 for `r sum(pure_rows$N1)` of `r nrow(pure_rows)` pure
  composites. S1 `r if (s1) "passes" else "fails"` (exponent `r sprintf("%.2f", exponent)`, peak
  RSS `r sprintf("%.0f", max(scaling$max_rss_mib))` MiB, four samples at
  `r sprintf("%.2f", scaling$seconds[[5L]] / base)`×).
- **Where the two models land on the same optimum they agree exactly.** In
  `r sum(gain_rows$chr18_copies == gain_rows$chr18_copies_upstream)` of `r nrow(gain_rows)` gain
  composites the port and upstream give chromosome 18 the same copy number and the same fraction to
  four decimals, with every bin in the same state. The disagreements sit on flat objectives: pure
  samples and the smallest gains, where the normal fraction is near 1 and ploidy and states are not
  identified, or starts where one optimizer climbed to a different local maximum. Among the starts
  outside A4, the port's objective ended higher than upstream's by more than 1 in `r higher` and
  lower in `r lower`; both optimizers find local maxima, as the design note says.
- **A single altered chromosome does not identify the fraction.** Both models see the planted
  shift (chromosome 18 median log2 ratio against the designed `log2(1 + m/2)` in the table) and
  explain it as a higher copy number in a smaller share of cells: extra copies times fraction is
  close to `m`, the called copy number is 3 only when `m` is small enough for the prior to prefer it.
  This is the model's known degeneracy on genomes with one event, shared with upstream, so G1 as
  declared (three copies at fraction `m`) fails for both; a fraction is identified when a genome
  carries changes of more than one magnitude, which this design does not plant.
- **Samples without change report no fraction** (at most
  `r sprintf("%.3f", max(pure_rows$tumour_fraction))` from the port, `r sprintf("%.3f", max(pure_rows$tumour_fraction_upstream))` from upstream); the guard fired
  on `r sum(pure_rows$status == "guard_zero")` of them, the rest converged to a normal fraction near
  1, whose ploidy and copy numbers are not evidence.

Every table above is written under `benchmarks/results/depth-state/`; the per-segment tables are
gzip-compressed.
